LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ShadowCloak.label: [Raven] Death-Bringer Black Sun Cloak
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ShadowCloak.description: The exclusive uniform of the Raven Fusang organization's elite assassins, the "Death-Bringer Black Sun." Those who earn this uniform are among the strongest scouts. It is woven from ultra-high-density hyperweave blended with Raven Darkfeather Steel fibers, its surface covered in microscopic optical polarizers carved from Raven Dark-Sun Lenses.\n\nThis cloak is not just physical defense; it is like a flowing abyss. Wearing it means giving up the right to bathe in the sunlight, completely transforming into the sharpest invisible blade of the Raven Fusang organization. Only by assembling both the cloak and the hat can its true stealth and disengagement capabilities be realized.
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ShadowHat.label: [Raven] Death-Bringer Black Sun Hat
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_ShadowHat.description: The exclusive hat of the Raven Fusang organization's elite assassins, the "Death-Bringer Black Sun." This matching wide-brimmed hat features a pitch-black polarizing veil draping from its edges. It perfectly conceals the wearer's facial features and any gaze, making the assassin look like an emotionless grim reaper. It has a built-in complex auxiliary targeting system and is the absolute symbol of a grandmaster assassin.
